rules: Operator launch and native preflight precede execution; these entries do not dispatch agents.
Preserve six assignments for three final reviews, delivery and bounded rechecks.
Before each dispatch bind exact required artifacts, hashes, approved writable modules, time/attempt limits and acceptance evidence.
Soft dependencies permit labeled preparation only; hard dependencies gate acceptance.
Disposition dependencies require an honest result or bounded blocker, never fabricated success.
No duplicate root, recursive spawning, concurrent shared-file writes or author self-review.
Final reviews may assess a useful partial outcome; no missing execution becomes PASS.

tasks.objective: Verify exact setup/baseline, source availability and native delegation; return bounded inventory.
Publish compact module/path ownership and accepted-contract mapping; then yield slot.
Run persistent two-person app with useful deterministic answers, sharing, corrections and local drafts.
Implement owned benign-worker lifecycle and fault hooks; prepare granted runtime acquisition without inference before gate.
Author independent functional/HTTP/browser/lifecycle fixtures, observer and protected-evaluation plan.
Focused independent source/authority/concurrency review; return exact findings for authors.
Execute independent benign-process fault and stop observations; retain failures and controls.
Integrate owned job/answer path and UI; address relevant findings without self-acceptance.
Execute useful positive/negative HTTP/browser/state workflows and report exact candidate evidence.
Identify one artifact/runtime/rights; demonstrate dedicated backend launch/deadline/stop within readiness/lifecycle allocation, or record blocker.
Actually inspect artificial pixels and bind supported/forbidden expected assertions; report modality limitation if unavailable.
Bind resolved findings, source/config/environment/fixture identities and final allocations; model admission requires its gates, not just a disposition.
Run bounded final deterministic suite and eligible 72-call pilot; preserve all partial/failure outcomes and protection limits.
Assemble frozen source/evidence manifest, exact contract-use map, honest implemented/deferred scope; do not self-accept.
Independent final actual-code/authority verdict at exact frozen revision.
Independent final usefulness and cumulative-vision verdict with actual versus deferred capabilities.
Independent final evidence/attempt/oracle/claim audit; no fake empirical or canonical promotion.
Sanitize/publish permitted results, MORNING_REPORT/RESUME and exact owned shutdown; partial/blocker handoff allowed, no automatic merge.
